applies_to.preservation: The original protocol, five attempt receipts, qualification report, and 30-file root SHA256SUMS are unchanged. This append-only erratum supersedes only the RSS resource interpretation.

finding.correct_interpretation: The field is only the largest live process-tree RSS snapshot observed by the 0.5-second polling loop. Since every arm completed in about 0.53 seconds, the recorded value does not establish an OS-reported high-water mark or a complete process-tree peak.
superseded_claims: 3,915,776 bytes is the measured peak process-tree RSS for the arms.
The 4 GiB resource threshold passed or transient limit breaches were excluded.

independent_reproduction.method: A child waited 0.15 seconds, touched a 91 MiB allocation, then exited 0.05 seconds later. The first process-tree sample was 4,046,848 bytes; after a 0.5-second gap, wait4 reported a direct-child high-water mark of 107,511,808 bytes.
independent_reproduction.scope_limit: wait4 supplies the OS high-water mark for the direct waited child. It is not a complete concurrent process-tree high-water mark; transient aggregate peaks across unreported descendants remain unexcluded.

revised_interpretation.behavioral_source_result: Unchanged: baseline attempt-002 failed the two intended assertions and passed three controls, wrong-mutant v2 was rejected by its intended assertion and passed four controls, and upstream-fixed passed all five cases. The first baseline setup failure and first wrong-mutant design failure remain preserved.
revised_interpretation.resource_gate: INCONCLUSIVE: consumed runs do not establish that peak process-tree RSS stayed below 4 GiB.
revised_interpretation.qualification_scope: The source behavior result remains limited to the five frozen request-model cases. Do not treat the old RSS values as evidence that a future Development attempt is resource-safe.
revised_interpretation.retry_policy: Do not rerun these consumed arms or reuse source qualification protocol v1. Any future execution requires a new protocol and runner hash.
